newsitem.title: FINLAND: TUOMIOJA NEW HEAD OF SDP PARLIAMENT GROUP - AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: TUOMIOJA NEW HEAD OF SDP PARLIAMENT GROUP - AGENCY.

text.p: Erkki Tuomioja was elected to succeed Pertti Paasio as chairman of the Social Democratic Party (SDP) parliamentary group, Finnish STT news agency reported on Thursday.
"He beat his rival candidate Jouko Skinnari in the second round of voting with the votes 32 to 29," STT said.
Paasio will quit in November to become member of the European parliament.
